# Security Policy

This repository contains the source code for my personal website, [trinelandsem.no](https://trinelandsem.no). It is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare.

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security issue on the website or in this repository, please report it privately:

- **Preferred:** use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/tlandsem/tlandsem.github.io/security/advisories/new) for this repository.
- **Alternative:** use the [contact form](https://trinelandsem.no/contact.html) on the website.

Please include a short description of the issue, the affected page or file, and steps to reproduce it if possible.

Please do not disclose the issue publicly before it has been fixed. I will acknowledge your report as soon as I can, usually within a week, and let you know when it has been resolved.

## Scope

- The website trinelandsem.no and its subpages
- The code and configuration in this repository

Automated scans, denial-of-service testing and social engineering are out of scope.

Thank you for helping keep this site secure.
